newsitem.title: USA: Montana 700 MW Colstrip unit going off line Tues.
newsitem.headline: Montana 700 MW Colstrip unit going off line Tues.

text.p: The 700 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the Colstrip coal-fired unit near Billings, Mont., is in the process of shutting down due to a tube leak, a spokesman for the plant's operator, Montana Power Co, said Tuesday.
The unit is expected to be down between 12 and 48 hours. "It should be back up no later than Thursday," the spokesman said.
Colstrip's other units, two at 330 MW and another at 700 MW, were operating normally, he added.
Other equity owners include Puget Sound Power and Light, Washington Water Power, Portland General Electric and Pacific Power and Light.
